option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf, which includes dextrocardia and specific coronary artery occlusion.

The option precisely matches the detailed diagnosis provided in the leaf, including mirror-image dextrocardia, acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction, and proximal right coronary artery occlusion.

Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) describes a type of MI that is part of the more comprehensive diagnosis in the leaf, but it omits the crucial detail of dextrocardia and the specific coronary artery involvement.

Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion is a significant part of the diagnosis but omits the critical finding of dextrocardia, which is present in the leaf.
